subject: Final committee resolution: Senior ML Engineer (REQ-287) — closure
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Hiring committee packet — Senior ML Engineer (REQ-287)

Team — attaching the final packet for Alex Mercer (Senior ML Engineer, REQ-287). Please review ahead of the committee call tomorrow. Quick summary: 

- Candidate: Alex Mercer (external) — strong systems/infra + model deployment experience.
- Interview signal: PM + tech + matching with product needs; interview notes attached.
- Compensation: target ask discussed with recruiter: $235k base + 0.25% equity.
- Redwood comp band (Senior ML Eng, SF market): $180,000 – $220,000 base; total comp budgets constrained this quarter.
- Headcount: this req is part of Q1 net-new headcount (approved 1FTE), but finance flagged a temporary hiring freeze for new budgeted roles until CFO review (email linked in packet).

As a reminder, committee votes needed: Approve offer at band/top of band (<=$220k), approve out-of-band exception (>=$221k) with justification, or close no-hire. If we approve an exception we need VP + Finance signoff (per compensation policy).

Attachments: Alex_Mercer_Resume.pdf, REQ-287_interview_notes.pdf, comp_band_summary.xlsx

Thanks — please reply with your vote and brief rationale if you can before the call. If not, we will take votes post-call.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 11:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Hiring committee packet — Senior ML Engineer (REQ-287)

Thanks Marissa — read the packet. My take: strong candidate, would materially speed up some of the infra work on low-latency routing and the KV cache lifecycle. I think the team should make a competitive offer.

Suggested path: Offer $220k base (top of band) + 0.25% equity and a six-month performance bonus (one-time) of $10k to bridge comp expectations while keeping headcount within budgeted band. If committee approves, I will prepare the role-level business case and take to Finance for the bonus carve-out.

Vote: APPROVE (with the proposal above). Rationale: product impact is high, and we have the headcount already budgeted — this keeps within base band but uses a small one-time bonus as flexibility.

—Laura

Director, Applied ML | Redwood Inference

Marissa / Laura — read everything. Respectfully I vote NO on an out-of-band payment or additional bonus for this role at this time. Two reasons: 1) Finance just flagged a temporary hiring spend freeze for new roles until we close the quarter; any exceptions are only for mission-critical roles with documented revenue impact (this one is important but not urgent). 2) We need to keep compensation discipline — the band exists for a reason and we should not set a precedent of one-off top-band concessions.

If Laura believes this candidate is mission-critical today, we can re-open after a quick business case to justify an exception. Otherwise I recommend closing the req and keeping the bench open for later Q2 recruiting when the budget is clear.

Vote: NO (no exception).

—Vivek

I reviewed the interview notes and comp band file. Signal is solid and I empathize with the hiring team on finding match-level candidates being harder this quarter. My vote: ABSTAIN from an out-of-band exception — I support trying to keep the offer within band. If Laura wants to pursue the $220k + one-time $10k bonus (structured as a relocation/retention payment if needed) I will not block it, but I would not greenlight anything above $220k base.

Vote: ABSTAIN (support top-of-band plus a single one-time make-whole payment, not a recurring comp change).

—Aditya

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:00:00 -08:00
Subject: Final resolution — REQ-287 (Senior ML Engineer)

Thanks all for the rapid reviews and votes. Consolidating:

- Laura: APPROVE if we structure as $220k base + 0.25% equity + $10k one-time bonus (business-case routed to Finance).
- Vivek: NO to any exception; prefers keeping req closed until budget clarity.
- Aditya: ABSTAIN; supports top-of-band + one-time payment (nonrecurring).

Given the split and the Finance hiring-spend freeze (formal guidance from FP&A last week), we do not have the required VP+Finance approvals to push an out-of-band exception today. Per policy, a majority of committee with VP + Finance signoff is required for exceptions. We therefore will:

1) CLOSE the req for now as "no hire — candidate paused".
2) Marissa (recruiting) will send a closeout note to the candidate with positive feedback and an ask to keep in touch.
3) Mark REQ-287 as closed in Greenhouse and retain the candidate in our pipeline for Q2 re-evaluation.
4) Laura: if you want to re-open in Q2, prepare a short business case outlining revenue/MTTR impact so we can queue for exception review.

Aditya: please confirm HR/Comp will be prepared to escalate the case if we re-open. Vivek: if Finance signals any change, I will re-circulate.

Action: Marissa to draft candidate close note below and send final closure after 24 hours for additional edits.

--- draft closeout email (for review) ---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@gmail.com>, Kate Long <kate@talentbridge.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:00:00 -08:00
Subject: REQ-287 — update from Redwood Interview Process

Hi Alex — thank you again for your time and for the thoughtful conversations with the team. We were impressed by your background and the value you would bring. After careful consideration by the hiring committee, we are going to pause hiring for this role and will not be extending an offer at this time. This is primarily a budget and timing decision rather than a reflection of your qualifications. We would love to stay in touch and re-engage if the role re-opens in Q2. If you are open to it, I will keep your profile active in our pipeline and reach out with updates.

Wishing you the best, and please let me know if you want any feedback from the interview loop.

Best —
Marissa

--- end draft ---

Please flag edits to the candidate note within 24 hours. If I don't hear objections, I'll send the note to Alex + Kate and update Greenhouse accordingly.
